name: Holiday Sweet Potato Casserole with Marshmallows & Pecans (Nut Stricture Warning)
whyItWorks: The whipped sweet potato base is soothing, but holiday casseroles are heavily topped with crunchy whole or chopped pecans which present a dangerous obstruction risk for stricturing Crohn's.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid nut-topped versions if stricture-prone. Scoop sweet potato strictly from the bottom center where no pecans have settled.
watchOuts: Hard pecan nut fragments can lodge in bowel strictures
